args.sql:
WITH engagement_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        txkey,
        CASE 
            WHEN (therapy_details ->> 'engagement')::text = 'High' THEN 3
            WHEN (therapy_details ->> 'engagement')::text = 'Medium' THEN 2
            WHEN (therapy_details ->> 'engagement')::text = 'Low' THEN 1
            WHEN (therapy_details ->> 'engagement')::text = 'Non-compliant' THEN 0
            ELSE NULL
        END AS engagement_score
    FROM treatmentbasics
)
SELECT 
    txkey,
    AVG(engagement_score) AS tes
FROM 
    engagement_scores
GROUP BY 
    txkey;

    SELECT
        txkey,
        CASE
            WHEN (therapy_details ->> 'engagement')::text = 'High' THEN 3
            WHEN (therapy_details ->> 'engagement')::text = 'Medium' THEN 2
            WHEN (therapy_details ->> 'engagement')::text = 'Low' THEN 1
            WHEN (therapy_details ->> 'engagement')::text = 'Non-compliant' THEN 0
            ELSE NULL
        END AS engagement_score
    FROM treatmentbasics
)
SELECT
    txkey,
    AVG(engagement_score) AS tes
FROM
    engagement_scores
GROUP BY
    txkey;
```

The main query then calculates the average engagement score (TES) for each treatment identifier (`txkey`).
